flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a sizable rise in the Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate. The projected seat count recently changed to 54-46, up from 53-47, which means Democrats gain control. [[Iowa]] is a newly predicted flip, with the Democrat Josh Turek gaining a moderate amount of ground, while in [[South Carolina]] the Republican Darline Graham Nordone saw a sizable drop in their chances.
summaries.governor: The biggest shift came in [[Kansas]], where the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sharp drop in chances, and the market sees the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Vermont]], the Republican Phil Scott also slid sharply. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford lost a sizable amount of ground, and Polymarket odds mark that seat as a predicted flip as well.
summaries.house: Polymarket's projected House count now stands at 240-195, up from 239-196, which would mean Democrats gain control. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp rise in their chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], the Democrat Cait Conley slipped sharply against the Republican Mike Lawler, and the market lists it as a predicted flip.
